author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: an A-frame mast with a lower crossbar, a short inner signal arc and a taller outer arc on each side (the outer arcs now reach down to y 34), all mirrored about x = 24; it reads as a transmitting antenna. To fit two arcs per side with 8-unit clearance, the mast is shorter than in the reference and the inner arcs sit above its apex.
omissions: The mast is shorter than the reference's (apex at y26) so that the inner arcs clear it.
drawing_plan: SQUARE: mast (16,42)-(19,36)-(24,26)-(29,36)-(32,42); crossbar (19,36)-(29,36); inner arcs (18,8)-(18,20) rx2 ry6 and mirror; outer arcs (9,6)-(9,34) rx3 ry14 and mirror.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'radio-tower' (A mast with paired signal arcs).
